create_NunchakuSVDQLinearMethod: create a NunchakuSVDQLinearMethod instance with int4 or nvfp4 precision for quantized linear layers
create_NunchakuAWQLinearMethod: create a NunchakuAWQLinearMethod instance with configurable group size for AWQ quantized linear layers
build_quantized_linear_apply: build quantized forward pass by calling apply on NunchakuSVDQLinearMethod or NunchakuAWQLinearMethod with input tensor
create_weights_quantized_layer: create weights for a quantized linear layer using create_weights with input and output partition sizes
process_weights_after_loading: process weights after loading by calling process_weights_after_loading to freeze parameters as non-trainable
